censusMethod: AI-assisted full-page facsimile census of every visible lexical article start, reconciled against canonical v0.2 candidates and missed-start records
authorityNotes: The large centered `A.` on p.133 is an alphabetic section heading, not a lexical article.
The first lexical article is `A. denotando la persona que padece. A. Aa.` and begins before canonical candidate p133-L-001.
Candidate p133-L-002 is superseded by `p133_opening_resolution.jsonl` and is treated as a continuation/oversegmentation within the first article.
Visible starts absorbed within merged candidates count as false negatives for start detection even when their containing candidate is a true positive.
Cross-column and cross-page articles count once, at their visible start location.

controlEvidence.use: secondary corroboration of the opening entry only; not authority over the 1737 witness
controlEvidence.openingAgreement: A, denotando la persona que padece. A, Aa.

interpretation: The control pages now have a closed machine-collated inventory of visible article starts. Performance is strongly page-dependent: p.133, where the extractor retains the conservative first-page behavior and encounters the opening heading/entry geometry, has substantially lower recall than p.134. These page-level figures are diagnostic and not probabilistic estimates for the full vocabulary.
